notablePrerequisites:
You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{U}.
Fractured Realm is unlocked.
description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{U}.
Cast Great Whale by paying {5}{U}{U}.
When Great Whale enters the battlefield, it triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Holding priority, activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{U}.
Resolve the second Great Whale trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Bottomless Pool.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Bottomless Pool.
Bottomless Pool triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, returning Great Whale from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the second trigger, choosing not to return anything to your hand.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Marina.
Repeat.
